title: What an evening!
transcript: Why are there chess boards on these tables? Well, you see, this is the closing ceremony of [music] the London Chess Classic, which means that the majority of the people here are chess players. The dinner was filled with exciting chess activities, like blindfolded games by Super Grand Masters, an auction for charity that gave it the chance to play against the winner of the tournament. And I was lucky enough to play some games against some of the world's finest players. Of course, I lost all of the games, [laughter] but still, this was so much fun, and I am so grateful that I got the opportunity to live this experience. Thank you so much London Chess Classic for having
